objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-29 ('Yes, let's continue'), taking the recommendation of EXACT-TOWERS-20261029-001: exact self-reproduction proved finitely ramified for private substitution, so test substitution with shared boundaries. On the triangular-lattice torus, cut every triangle into k^2 with the new vertices shared between neighbours (scale k = 2 and 3), with copies of one knot on all triangles (S1, placements per up and per down triangle) or on up triangles only (S2). The fine lattice is the same lattice scaled by 1/k, so the rule is self-similar, and the space is not finitely ramified. A rule is set-level exact when the fine solutions restricted to the coarse sublattice are exactly the coarse solutions, and counted exact when every coarse solution has the same number of extensions. Questions: (1) which rules are exact, at which scales; (2) their solution structure: entropy density and whether the solution sets are affine; (3) what exactness on genuine two-dimensional space leaves of emergence: under the source-aware reading a knot is native only where finite changes flip its variables. Scoping: at scale 2, 22 of 122 rules are exact; all have affine solution sets and zero entropy density; they are parity on up triangles (the Newman-Moore model), parity and three-excluded laws frozen on all triangles (Baxter-Wu ground states), and twisted not-all-equal collapsed to equality lines; not-all-equal (Wannier's antiferromagnet) is never exact. Intuitions targeted: space from logic without a drawn space; the two/three boundary (exactness pushes laws to affine or pairwise structure); universally influential cycles; everything relational. No time constraints.
status: Complete 2026-10-29: shared-boundary self-reproduction on the triangular lattice. The families: Newman-Moore parity on up triangles (exact at scale 2 by (1 + S)^2 = 1 + S^2, rigid), Baxter-Wu parity on all triangles (colour classes, exact at scale 2, rigid) with twelve three-excluded rules equal to it on tori up to side 11, and twisted not-all-equal collapsed to equality lines (exact at every scale, no knot on any triangle). Exactness on genuine two-dimensional space keeps a knot only through parity. Next: is exact self-reproduction on genuine space always affine (2/3), deferred to the owner.
